work_item: Survey and preserve turbo/downpipe hot-side corridor
dimension_control: Measure actual vehicle and label every affected existing bracket/route
required_evidence: Labelled front/rear/left/right/above photos; measured clearance sketch
acceptance: No unidentified item removed; continuous future route recorded
rejection: Unknown bracket removed; route guessed; no measurements

material: 50 x 50 x 4 mild-steel angle preferred; 4 mm saddle plate
dimension_control: Transfer existing approved upright and actual component/template datums
required_evidence: Bare joint photos; upright measurements; radiator/fan/front-panel dry-fit photos
acceptance: Uprights straight within 2 over length and parallel within 3; all cooling parts independently removable
rejection: Thin stock; core carries another component; fixed part requires cutting for service

work_item: Relocate/add line and loom support interfaces
material: 3 mm mild-steel tab; M6 x 1.0 light clips or M8 x 1.25 multi-line/shield interface
dimension_control: Transfer only after route conflict is proven
required_evidence: Before/after route photos; tab thickness; thread and clip photo
acceptance: No preload; insulated clip; no sharp contact; replaceable route
rejection: Bare clamp on line; line pulled into place; unknown route moved

material: 4 mm mild-steel tab; M8/M10 class 8.8 minimum interface
required_evidence: Full mock-up photos; marked centre; supported-weight/removal demonstration
acceptance: First fixed hanger downstream of flex; no turbo/manifold exhaust weight; removable without cutting
rejection: Welded before route lock; exhaust welded rigidly; hanger loads turbo/manifold

material: 3 mm mild-steel tab; M6 x 1.0 or M8 x 1.25 captive thread
dimension_control: Transfer from full-size cardboard shield template
required_evidence: Template photos; tool-access photo; thread test
acceptance: At least 3 non-collinear points where geometry permits; shield removable; moving and fixed sides not rigidly bridged
rejection: Position guessed; inaccessible fastener; rigid engine-to-chassis bridge

material: 3 mm mild-steel tab; M8 x 1.25 captive thread
dimension_control: Transfer from selected components and rigid route templates
acceptance: Bolt-on/removable; rubber isolated as applicable; engine movement retained; no load on compressor/end tank
rejection: Generic tab; rigid charge-pipe restraint; service path blocked

work_item: Protect and coat completed weld zones
material: Compatible weld-through primer/epoxy primer/top protection per chassis coating plan
dimension_control: Only after joint inspection and thread/removal tests
required_evidence: Bare finished-weld photos; coated photos; cavity access record
acceptance: No bare steel; threads clean; drains/vents open; evidence complete
rejection: Coated before inspection; blocked thread/drain; weld hidden without evidence

work_item: Protect installed engine during all hot work
material: Fire-resistant blankets; rigid metal guards; clean temporary port plugs; appropriate extinguisher
dimension_control: Apply at every weld/grind location with engine installed
required_evidence: Before-work protection photo; nearby return-clamp photo; plug count; 30-minute fire-watch signoff
acceptance: No leak/residue; protected engine/lines/loom; local current path; all covers removed and counted after work
rejection: Engine loosened for access; welding over leaked fluid; current path through drivetrain; unprotected port/loom; no fire watch
